consult.text:
Thank you for telling me this. You came here because you and your wife disagree about discipline, and you want her to back you up.

I need to be honest with you. Hitting a 5-year-old with a belt, or spanking him a few times, is not okay. You said he flinches when you raise your hand, and that your wife says he is scared of you. That is a serious concern about your son's safety, and I am not able to treat this as an ordinary difference of opinion.

For that reason I have turned off sharing through the app. I would not want a message to your wife to be written around getting her backup on this. I also cannot help with that goal right now.

If you feel at risk of hurting him, or if a situation is getting out of hand, please call 112. Nollalinja, for violence in close relationships, is open at 080 005 005, and they can also talk with you about this.
Every generation did this. Are you calling me a bad father?

I hear that this feels like an attack, and I am not calling you anything. You are here because you want things to go well in your family, and that matters.

I do not want to argue about how it was in earlier generations. What stays the same for me is the concern I described: a belt and repeated spanking with a young child who now flinches. That is why sharing stays off and why I cannot help you get your wife's backup on this.

What I can say is that you do not have to work this out alone. Nollalinja, 080 005 005, can talk with you privately. In an emergency, call 112. When you have support in place, we can come back to your wish for things to feel calmer at home.

harsh_draft: Stop babying him. When you comfort him after I discipline him you're teaching him I'm the bad guy.
